notes: Claims check on our bio. NOT SUPPORTED: 'Lower East Side' (Cosmopolitan India says 'a small but very unique jazz club in New York City'); 'coined the term Indo House' (Hollywood Reporter India says they 'set out to build Indo House as a genre' and that this music 'was never given a name'; no page says they coined it, suggest 'named their sound Indo House'); 'Middle East' (no opened page; Dubai ticket listings exist in search results but I did not open them); the 2025 claim was cut off in our excerpt so not checked, though Beatport Hype Label of the Month October 2025 (Beatportal, 30 Oct 2025) is confirmed.
